entry.name: Mozilla Firefox ESR
entry.source: preinstalled (firefox.exe and xul.dll byte-identical to the verified 52.9.0esr win32 installer, installed on xp)
entry.verified: browser: binaries match verified 52.9.0esr build (SHA512SUMS gpg-verified (Mozilla release key 14F2 6682 D091 6CDD 81E3 7B6D 61B7 B526 D98F 0353, subkey BBBEBDBB24C6F355), installer SHA512 matches; Authenticode signer Mozilla Corporation, digest matches, chain not verifiable locally (SHA1 sig, Symantec timestamp root not in store)); driver: no signature or checksum published (unsigned exe from the GitHub release over HTTPS)
entry.notes: Preinstalled, update channel esr. geckodriver 0.17.0 is the release matched to Firefox 52 (0.17-0.21 all start on Vista). Runs windowed in the SSH (service) session: works, headless not available in FF52. REQUIRED CHANGE: with the default content sandbox, e10s content processes die in that session (MessageChannel 'cannot send/recv', page loads hang), so C:\Program Files\Mozilla Firefox\distribution\distribution.ini sets security.sandbox.content.level=0 (test VM only; remove the file to revert).
